elements.name: Apply an inserted model-state table row

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State
the user sets the extrusion to Suppress in Primary and Capture State and Compute in Copy State through the model-state table
The MCAD Software has a model-state table with Capture State followed by active Copy State
the extrusion is suppressed in Capture State and computed in Copy State
the user inserts a row after Capture State
the generated member appears between Capture State and Copy State in the model browser
the user activates the generated member
the generated member is marked active
the extrusion row is struck through
the solid is absent from the viewport
